title: New World's starter kits invent no offer price or free promise

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-18: "Make every Frequency theme FULLY generic with copy that coaches them what to write. Be sure anybody using a theme keeps their content but give the templates a full scrub." Depth ruled the same day on the card: "Strip specifics, keep ready copy".

detail: New World's seven starter kits (lib/sites/kits/new-world-variants.ts) kept their three offers behind slot tokens, but the sample words inside each token were prices ($15 to $160, From $5 / mo) and 'Free', so a new Space with no offers of its own published a stranger's prices. The sample prices are now empty (a Space's own offer prices still fill the slot), the home stats show each offer's length instead of its price, and every free promise in the kits (first visit free, free class, membership is free, most of it is free to walk into) is ready copy without the promise.
